regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, article metadata, and Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: Verified the source title and aggregate claim of >25 allenyne examples plus gold/rhodium applications. The online SI notice does not establish a workspace SI association and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 two-column Introduction and prior mechanochemical metal/copper discussion
regions.finding: Classified cited mechanochemical metal activation, Sonogashira, cyclopropenation, Glaser, and solution copper-allenylidene chemistry as background/prior work. The concrete arrows are mapped to Figure 1 on page 2 rather than counted as current experiments.

unresolved: Introduction statements are aggregate/contextual and do not supply complete experiment-specific charges or outcomes.

regions.finding: Recorded the generic passivated-to-activated metal concept and the two cited Browne 2019/ Ito 2021 mechanochemical examples as non-current records.

Recorded the three cited Mack/Borchardt copper-activation precedents separately, retaining visible catalyst/media, time, and frequency facts. They are literature examples, not current-paper experiments.
Separated the cited Zhu solution copper-allenylidene pathway from the current generic metallic-copper/base mechanosynthesis. Generic pathways were not assigned Table 1 yields.

regions.region: page 2 lower Results and Discussion optimization narrative
regions.finding: Mapped the 0.2 mmol model reaction, Cu 5.1 mg/40 mol%, DIPEA 1 equiv, steel jar/bead, CH3CN η=1, 30 Hz/2 h/room temperature/air conditions and all entry-specific observations to Table 1 rows on page 3. No prose duplicates were created.

unresolved: SI Sections 4 and 7 are unassociated and were not used.
Optimization workups, purifications, product masses, and several detection limits are absent.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1–13, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all thirteen source rows independently with shared procedure facts, row-specific Cu loading/base/grinding-agent/time/frequency/LAG/component omissions, CH2Br2 NMR basis, isolated 82% for entry 9, bounded <5%, n.d., no-conversion, and decomposition statements. ZnO/NaCl remain one grouped row because the source prints one outcome for two attempts.
Mapped stated yields for 2a–2t and the acyl/aroyl/substitution trends to individual Figure 2 records on page 4; the 0.2 mmol 2a/82% record is merged with Table 1 entry 9.

Recorded three Figure 3A kinetic series, six Figure 3B solution controls, and the Ar model control as independent current experiments. The ≈90% starting-material recoveries remain recovery outcomes, not product yields.

regions.region: page 3 right-column catalyst-exclusion and mechanism discussion
regions.finding: Cu2O, CuO, and CuBr2 exclusions are referred only to unassociated SI and were not instantiated. The proposed CuI-generation interpretation is linked to Figure 3C rather than treated as observed intermediate preparation.

unresolved: The grouped Table 1 entry 8 does not assign separate 10% outcomes to ZnO and NaCl.
Kinetic graph point values are not tabulated and were not estimated.
Cu-oxide/bromide catalyst tests are SI-only and unavailable.

regions.region: page 4 Figure 2 reaction header and caption
regions.finding: Applied the displayed 0.2 mmol substrate, Cu 40 mol%, DIPEA 2 equiv, CTAB 1 equiv, CH3CN η=1, 5 mL steel jar, 10 mm steel bead, 30 Hz/2 h conditions to each scope row. No row-specific copper mass was inferred.

Recorded all 29 displayed product outcomes: 2a is merged with Table 1 entry 9, the remaining 28 are distinct scope records, and the separate 1 mmol/65% 2a annotation is an independent scale-up. Printed dr values for 2q, 2r, 2t, and 2ab are retained.
Mapped wire/bolt tests to the Figure 3 model reactions on page 5; the powder 82% result is the existing optimized entry 9. Abrasion is retained without inventing copper mass or dimensions.
Linked alkynyl-copper, allenylidene A, mixed species B, insertion species C, and protodecupration to one proposed-mechanism record. Proposed intermediates are not preparations.

unresolved: Figure 2 omits row workups, purifications, masses, and most selectivity measurement bases.
Bulk copper wire/bolt quantities and dimensions are not reported.

regions.finding: Recorded separate Cu0-powder, 90 min/30 Hz pre-milled Cu0, and CuBr 40 mol% kinetic series. Only stated induction-period observations were structured; plotted point coordinates were not estimated.

regions.region: page 5 Figure 3B solution controls and model copper-source images
regions.finding: Recorded six temperature/treatment-specific 24 h CH3CN solution controls and separate wire/bolt model reactions. Powder 82% is merged with Table 1 entry 9; wire and bolt each give reported 55%, with copper amount and yield basis unresolved.
Classified aerobic Cu0→CuI activation and intermediates A–C as a proposed mechanism, not experimentally isolated species or duplicate preparations of 2a.

regions.region: page 5 Figure 3D and adjacent late-stage prose
regions.finding: Recorded three distinct transformations: basic deprotection to 3 (90%), JohnPhos-gold cyclization of 2f to 4 (65% isolated), and Rh/CO cyclocarbonylation of 2a to 5 (67%). The Figure-3D top substrate is labeled 2k/OAc while prose calls it 2a; both are retained as an unresolved source conflict.
Conclusion restates the reaction/mechanistic claims; acknowledgments, conflict statement, and author contributions add no experiments.

unresolved: Figure 3 kinetic graph points and several control charges/bases are not tabulated.
Deprotection starting-material conflict: Figure labels 2k/OAc, prose says 2a.
Late-stage transformations omit several scales, volumes, workups, masses, and yield bases.
